runtimeFixturePlacements.sourceContract: Create 6.0.10 RotationPropagator small-cog to small-cog connection is one-block face-adjacent, equal-axis, ratio -1; Simulated exposes the Swivel hidden extra cog through ExtraBlockPos to the same propagation search.
Create 6.0.10 CreativeMotorBlock has a shaft only toward FACING; UP therefore shafts directly into the Y-axis test cog one block above. CreativeMotorBlockEntity default generated speed is 16 RPM.

sourceEvidence: Create commit ac0c444d9828da3453ae8cc65338e8de063286fb registers exact blocks create:creative_motor and create:cogwheel.
CreativeMotorBlock.hasShaftTowards returns true only on its FACING side; facing=up drives the cog above along the Y axis.
CreativeMotorBlockEntity.DEFAULT_SPEED is 16 RPM and generated speed is exposed through the real Create kinetic source contract.
Create RotationPropagator gives adjacent equal-axis small cogwheels a -1 speed ratio.
Simulated SwivelBearingBlockEntity owns a hidden small-cog ExtraKinetics block entity whose axis is the Swivel FACING axis.
Simulated RotationPropagatorMixin exposes that hidden cog through ExtraBlockPos during Create kinetic neighbor discovery.
SwivelBearingBlockEntity integrates targetAngleDegrees from its hidden cog speed each tick; this probe therefore does not set target angle directly.

runtimeObligations.method: inject the two-block test fixture after accepted rudder child capture, prove the Creative Motor and transfer cog form a real kinetic path to the Swivel extra cog, and measure nonzero hidden-cog RPM
tick the real kinetic network and Swivel, then compare signed target-angle change against observed hidden-cog RPM and Create's rpm-to-degrees-per-tick conversion
remove the temporary Creative Motor source, prove hidden-cog RPM decays to zero, and verify the locked Swivel target angle stops integrating and holds without directly mutating its target
